title: Nobody is coming to *save you.* Here's what that means.

label: NOBODY IS COMING TO
head: Wake you up
sub: Put the alarm across the room. Get up on the first ring.

label: NOBODY IS COMING TO
head: Fix your body
sub: 20 pushups today. 21 tomorrow. Nobody can do them for you.

label: NOBODY IS COMING TO
head: Build your money
sub: Move 10% of every paycheck out before you touch the rest.

label: NOBODY IS COMING TO
head: Find your friends
sub: Join one thing with the same faces every week. A gym class, a league, a club.

label: NOBODY IS COMING TO
head: Make you confident
sub: Keep one promise to yourself today. Then another tomorrow.

label: NOBODY IS COMING TO
head: Drag you out of your rut
sub: Take one small step today. Momentum does the rest.

pre: But here's the part nobody tells you:
text: Nobody is coming to *stop* you either.

head: Your life is 100% your responsibility. *That's the good news.*
